xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4562: Replace harness-name branches with declared harness capabilities

plan.title: Replace harness-name branches with declared harness capabilities
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Harness-specific behavior is decided by ~208 harness-name and transcript-kind string comparisons in 74 src files. Each new harness must find every check by hand; missed checks are silent gaps (Muse rows show the raw id 'muse', OpenCode receipts record the Claude channel, Kimi/Prime transcripts fall to the Claude metadata parser).
narratives.Proposal: Add HarnessCapabilities (16 required fields) to the shared HarnessBehavior table in packages/contracts so server, CLI and frontend read one declaration. Convert the ten densest files: behavior decisions read capabilities; adapter selection becomes exhaustive Record<HarnessTranscriptKind,…> tables or switches on declared kind fields, so no string comparison remains. Add a shrink-only per-file ratchet (scripts/lint-harness-branches.sh) audited for raises, lower it after the conversions, prove with a mocked fake runtime that capability sets drive behavior, and document the model. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4562.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Converting files outside the ten in the issue table (conversation-delivery.ts, conversation-forks.ts, agents/spawn.ts, agents/recovery.ts, settings-api.ts, conversations.ts normalizeHarness, conversation-restart-all.ts stay as-is, held by the ratchet)
- Any change to src/lib/harness-policy.ts
- Moving existing HarnessBehavior top-level booleans (supportsPtySupervisor, usesRpcFifo, usesCodexHome, steerKind, …) into capabilities
- Making HarnessBehavior.nativeCommands or effortLevels required
- Changing the missing/unknown-harness ⇒ claude-code fallback
- Counting switch/case harness statements in the ratchet
- Any behavior change other than the ConversationRow labels (Pi, Muse Code) and the OpenCode receipt channel (acp-initial-context)
- Raising scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt or hand-raising a ratchet baseline row
- Adding a test-only harness registration API

autoDecisions.summary: Declare HarnessCapabilities in packages/contracts as HarnessBehavior.capabilities rather than in src/lib/runtimes/types.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: The frontend can import only @overdeck/contracts, and the existing behavior table is already the per-runtime declaration; one record avoids two sources of truth. Record<RuntimeName, HarnessBehavior> makes tsc enforce that every runtime declares it.

autoDecisions.summary: Express parser/adapter selection as exhaustive Record tables or switches on declared kind fields instead of keeping exempt transcriptKind === chains.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue exempts adapter selection from 'no name branches' but its ratchet counts transcriptKind ===; tables dissolve the conflict, let the ten files reach zero, and make a missing entry a tsc error.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep one issue with plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's acceptance criteria bind the ten files, the lowered baseline and the fake-runtime proof; the projected-surface lint counts each root doc/script as its own subsystem.

autoDecisions.summary: Render ConversationRow labels from displayName (ohmypi shows 'Pi', muse shows 'Muse Code').
autoDecisions.rationale: Removes a hand-kept label list that already missed Muse; ohmypi support is being removed, so the 'oh-my-pi' wording change is low-cost.

autoDecisions.summary: Correct OpenCode's context receipt channel to 'acp-initial-context'.
autoDecisions.rationale: OpenCode launches through acp-host --context-file like acp; the old value was a fall-through default, and the receipt is audit-only metadata.

autoDecisions.summary: Inject the fake runtime by vi.mock of the @overdeck/contracts definition lookups.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mocking the definition module is the test equivalent of adding a declaration and needs no consumer change or test-only API.

autoDecisions.summary: Ratchet counts occurrences of any *harness/*Harness/transcriptKind identifier compared with ===/!== to a harness name or *-jsonl literal, both operand orders, excluding tests, comments, harness-policy.ts, runtime adapter files and runtimes/storage.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the issue's definition while catching conv.harness/requestedHarness variants and skipping typeof guards; occurrence counting makes multi-name conditions visible.

metadata.sizeJustification: The issue's acceptance criteria require all ten densest files converted, the ratchet lowered and a fake-runtime proof in one done-state; each conversion is its own small item with its own test file, which roughly doubles the file count, and root-level docs/scripts each count as a separate subsystem in the projected-surface lint. Remaining files are explicitly deferred to a follow-up issue.

items.title: Declare HarnessCapabilities on every HarnessBehavior in contracts

metadata.parallelSafeReason: Touches only packages/contracts files that no other item edits; downstream items wait on it via blocks edges.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Create packages/contracts/src/harness-capabilities.ts with the union types, interface HarnessCapabilities (16 readonly required fields), HARNESS_CAPABILITY_KEYS and eight <NAME>_CAPABILITIES constants with values exactly per the PRD 'Capability model' table. Add readonly capabilities: HarnessCapabilities to HarnessBehavior and to every behavior constant; OPENCODE_BEHAVIOR gets capabilities: OPENCODE_CAPABILITIES explicitly (full object, no ACP spread). Add normalizeHarnessName(raw: unknown): RuntimeName | null and isLegacyPiHarnessName(raw: unknown): boolean (using KNOWN_HARNESSES from ./types), and rewrite getHarnessBehavior as BEHAVIORS[normalizeHarnessName(harness) ?? 'claude-code']. Export the new module from index.ts. Do not change src/lib/runtimes/behavior.ts; consumers import the helpers from @overdeck/contracts.

items.title: Given packages/contracts/src/harness-capabilities.ts, when a reviewer reads interface HarnessCapabilities, then it declares exactly the 16 fields of the PRD table, each readonly, with no '?:' member and no member type containing undefined.

Given each of the eight runtime names, when harness-behavior.test.ts runs, then Object.keys(getRuntimeBehavior(name).capabilities) equals HARNESS_CAPABILITY_KEYS and every value is defined, and the per-runtime contextChannel, stopRuntimeOnStartFailure and initialPromptMustLand values match the PRD table.

Given OPENCODE_BEHAVIOR, when its capabilities are read, then hostEffortFlag is true, binaryConfigKey is null, contextChannel is 'acp-initial-context', and the object is not the ACP capabilities object.

Given normalizeHarnessName, when called with 'pi', 'codex', 'claude', 42 and undefined, then it returns 'ohmypi', 'codex', null, null and null; and getHarnessBehavior(undefined) returns CLAUDE_CODE_BEHAVIOR.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Generate scripts/harness-branches-baseline.txt with --update. Add lint:harness-branches to package.json and to the lint chain after lint:harness-storage. Given a fixture src tree, when a file exceeds its baseline row or a new file contains 'harness === \'codex\'', then the script exits 1 and names the file (the new-file case prints NEW).

narrative.Action: PRD WI-14. New test that vi.mocks @overdeck/contracts (normalizeHarnessName, getHarnessBehavior, getRuntimeBehavior) so 'fake-harness' resolves to a mutable vi.hoisted slot holding a whole fake HarnessBehavior ({ ...MUSE_BEHAVIOR, displayName, transcriptKind, capabilities }). Each case sets two opposite definitions: startConversationRuntime teardown (capabilities.stopRuntimeOnStartFailure), transformMessageForHarness (capabilities.attachmentDelivery; serves the dashboard message route), configuredHarnessBinaryPath (capabilities.binaryConfigKey), and declared adapter selection in summarizeConversationActivity (transcriptKind codex-rollout-jsonl then kimi-wire-jsonl, with a distinct temp transcript file per run because the activity cache key includes the path). Also assert every runtime in getGlobalRegistry().getAll() has all HARNESS_CAPABILITY_KEYS defined. If a consumer import bypasses the mock, change that import to @overdeck/contracts or src/lib/runtimes/behavior.js; never add a test-only registration API.
